claim: In Q4 2025, Apple's revenue came in at $165.3 billion or more.
summary: Apple's known quarterly revenue is around $90-124B, with fiscal Q4 2025 around $102.5B. $165.3B or more is far above any known result and is contradicted by prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Apple's revenue in Q4 2025 was at least $165.3 billion
sub_claims.note: From knowledge to cutoff 2026-01-04, Apple fiscal Q4 2025 revenue was about $102.5B and no Apple quarter had ever exceeded about $124B. $165.3B is far above any known Apple quarterly revenue.
